author: mostafa_gawad
title: JUMP ANIMATION Hiring Vector Background Artists
content: WE'RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS. JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More for Studio Projects
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We're looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we're open to collaboration / internships. Please send a PROFESSIONAL email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio, Rate per panel & for 60 panels, Rates for services, Turnaround Time, Programs / Software used, Preferred Payment Method (PayPal). NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE.

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens. How to apply: Follow us [@young.onion], drop a comment, Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! You can also mail us info@youngonion.in

author: philfalcowrites
title: Paid Comic Work: Apply for TRANSPHORIA Anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio!

author: kavanaghgareth
title: Paid Artist Open Call for Paradise Towers 2 Backup Strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! (Full details on @cutawaycomics post; send portfolio, deadline around Nov 29 based on comments.)
